book.name: Matayo
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Matayo

content: Uwangalalu wa chilebhi cha ukwate
Yesu akalongi nabhu kabheti kwa malenganesu,
“Ukolongwa wa kunani kumahunde ulengini na nkolongwa joakantendi mwana waki uwangalalu wa chilebhi cha ukwate.
Bhela akabhatumiki bhatumika bhaki kubhakema bhaakabhakokiki kuhika paukwate, nambu bhombi bhakakaniki kuhika.

Akabhatumiki kabheti bhatumika bhangi, akapwagha, ‘Mkabhapwaghila bhala bhanabhakokiki, kubha chilebhi chibhi tayale, njinjiki likambaku langu la ng'ombi, na ng'ombi yengi yeinenipe, na kila chindu chibhi tayale, muhikaye paukwati.’
Nambu bhombi ngachebhaholali ghanighala, bhakabohkiki, jongi akapiti kumighonda jaki, na jongi kumahengu ghaki,
na bhangi bhakabhakamwi bhatumika bhala na kubhalapula, na kubhakoma.
Nkolongwa jola akayomike, akabhatumiki manjolinjoli bhaki, bhakabhakoma bhala bhabhakomiki bhatumika bhaki, na kuuyonanga muchi wabho.
Kabhet akabhapwaghi bhatumika bhaki, ‘Uwangalalu wa chilebhi cha ukwati chibhi tayale, nambu bhabhakokakike ngechebhapalakikaje.
Bhela, njenda mwindela na bhokapi bhala bhamwabhonaje mubhakema bhahika paukwate.’
Bhala bhatumika bhakabhokike, bhakapiti mwindela, bhakabhaletiki bhandu bhokapi bhabahwene, bhahakau na bhambone. Nyumba ja ukwate jakatweli bhaghene.
“Nkolongwa paakajingi kwabhona bhaghene, akambweni mundu jumu jwangakuwata ingobhu ja ukwate.
Nkolongwa akundalukile, ‘Nkoche, bho, ujingi bholi pambane panga ingobhu ja ukwate?’ Nambu jombi akatemi chinunu.
Panihapa nkolongwa akabhapwagili bhatumika bhaki, ‘Munkonga magholu na mabhoku mukundekala kunja kulwihi. Konihoku analela na kuyagha mino.’ ”
Yesu akajomuli kwa kupwagha, “Bhamaheli bhabhakokakike, nambu bhahaghulika nde bhachokope.”
Kulepa Kode
Bhela, Mafalisayo bhakapiti, na kupwaghanila ntundu wa kunkamu Yesu kwa malobhi ghake.

Bhela, bhakabhatumiki bhabhulwa bhabhu papamu na bhahemba bhaka Helode kwaka Yesu. Bhakundalukile, “Mbola, tumanyi kubha wenga wa mundu wambone, na kubha ubhola indela jaka Chapanga kwa chakaka, ngacheunjoghopa mundu jokapi jola, panga kuholalela kubha bhandu bhapwagha kike.
Henu, utupwaghilaje maholalelu ghako, bho, wichu le kwitu au nga wichu kwitu, kulepa kode kwaka Kaisali?”
Nambu Yesu akaumanyi uhakau wabho, akabhapwaghile, “Mwenga mwakandumi kubhele, bho, mbona mnenga?
Mnangihaje mbija ja kulepela kode.” Na bhombi bhakumpeki lingengalema la mbija.
Bhela, Yesu akabhalalukile, “Bho, sula ajeji na lihina aleli yaka nane?”
Bhakamuyangike, “Nde yaka Kaisali.” Panihapa Yesu akabhapwagile, “Bhela, mumpekya Kaisali yeibhi yaki Kaisali, na mumpekya Chapanga yeibhi yaki Chapanga.”
Pabhajowini bhenibhela bhakakangichi namaa, bhakundekiki, na bhakabhokanile.
Lilalukilu panani ja kuhyoka kuhuma kwa bhakuwa
Lichobha lelalela, Masadukayo bhakumu bhabhapwagha bhabhawili ngachebhahyoka, bhakunjendi Yesu,
na kumpwaghila, “Mbola, Musa akapwaghiki mundu joatowili anaapotile panga na kundeka mwana, ipalika ndongu waki ampwelila mbomba joaweliwi na ndomi hoju, nahuli ambelakya ndongu waki bhana.
Henu, pitu pani pakabhi na bhalongu saba. Wa kutumbula akatowi mbomba, na akapotile, na maghambu ngacheakabhi na bhana, akandeki ndongu waki mbomba joaweliwi na ndomi jola.
Ikabi bhelabhela kwa ndongu wa kabhele, na wa katatu, mbaka wa saba.
Pakujomukela mbomba hoju najombi akapotile.
Bho, lichobha bhakuwa pabhiyokaje, mbomba hoju anaabya nhwanu waka nane pachilanda ja bhalongu saba bhala? Kwa ndandi bhokapi saba bhakabhi bhuntogwile.”
Yesu akabhayangike, “Mwanganya muhobhike, kwa ndandi ngachemughamanyi Malembu ghaka Chapanga, wala makili ghaka Chapanga.
Ndandi bhakuwa pabhiyokaje ngabhitogholi wala kutoghuleka, nambu bhibya ngati bhatumika bhaka Chapanga bha kunani kumahunde.
Nambu kubhokana na kuyoka kwa bhakuwa, bho, ngachemsomiki ghala ghaampwaghi Chapanga? Akapwaghike,
‘Nepani nde Chapanga waka Ibulahimu, Chapanga waka Isaka, na Chapnga waka Yakobo!’ Bhela, jombi nga Chapanga wa bhakuwa, nambu jombi nde Chapanga wa bhandu bhabhabhi bhome.”
Lipogha la bhandu lela palajowini ghanighala, bhakakangichi mabholu ghake.
Amuli ngolongwa
Bhela Mafalisayo pabhajowini kubha Yesu akabhi bhatumbalishi Masadukayo, bhakaketangini papamo.
Jumu wabhu, bambo Shelia, akandaluki Yesu kwa kundenga,
“Mbola, bho, amuli bhole nde ngolongwa mu Shelia jokapi?”
Yesu akayangiki, “ ‘Umpala Bambo Chapanga waku kwa mtima waku wokapi, na kwa roho jaku jokapi, na kwa malangu ghaku ghokapi.’
Jeniheji nde amuli ngolongwa na ja kutumbula.
Na ja kabheli jejilengana na jeniheji nde jenjenu, ‘Umpala njaku, ngati moulipali wamwete.’
Shelia jokapi na mabholu ghokapi gha bhalota bhaka Chapanga, ghategamela amuli ibheli hayeyi.”
Bho, Kristo nde Mwana waka nane?
Mafalisayo pabhalibhongini papamu, Yesu akabhalalukile,
“Bho, mwanganya mbona bholi panani jaka Kristo? Bho, nde mwana waka nane?” Bhakamuyangike, “Mwana waka Daude.”
Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Bhela, bho, iwezikana bholi kupwaga kwa makili ghaka Roho Mhuhu, Daude ankema jombi Bambo? Ndandi akapwaghike,

content.text: mbaka nabhabheka maadui bhaku pahi ja magholu ghako.’

content: Bhela, ngati anakubhi Daude ankema Kristo, ‘Bambo,’ bho, aweza bholi henu kubha mwana waki?”
Nga mundu nga jumu joakaweziki kumuyanga lilobhe. Na kutumbu lichobha leniheli nga mundu hata jumu joakalengiki kundalukila lilalukilu kabheti.
